content.value_statement: Growth teams need a coherent acquisition plan across channels, funnel stages, and regions. This skill provides playbooks, benchmarks, templates, measurement guidance, and a CAC calculator.
actual_capabilities: Builds full-funnel demand plans spanning awareness, consideration, decision, and sales handoff.
Provides channel playbooks for LinkedIn, Google, Meta, SEO, partnerships, affiliates, and co-marketing.
Defines HubSpot tracking, lead scoring, attribution, reporting, and handoff workflows.
Creates campaign briefs, budget allocations, testing plans, KPI dashboards, and optimization rules.
Calculates blended and channel-specific CAC from spend and acquired-customer counts.
Adapts acquisition recommendations for EU, United States, and Canadian markets.
limitations: Only the CAC calculator is bundled; referenced workflow, campaign, attribution, document, spreadsheet, and experiment files are absent.
The calculator uses hardcoded example data and requires editing or direct function use for real inputs.
Benchmarks are general guidance and do not replace current platform data, legal review, or controlled experiments.
The skill describes HubSpot and advertising setup but does not connect to those services or change campaigns.

use_cases.title: Plan an International Launch
use_cases.description: Create a channel mix, funnel plan, budget, and regional adjustments for a B2B SaaS expansion.

use_cases.title: Improve Paid Acquisition
use_cases.description: Compare channel performance, diagnose weak conversion points, and define budget scaling or pause rules.

use_cases.title: Align Measurement and Handoffs
use_cases.description: Define attribution, dashboards, lead stages, qualification criteria, routing, and response expectations.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Starter Acquisition Plan
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a 90-day demand plan for [company], serving [audience] with a monthly budget of [budget]. Recommend channels, funnel goals, and weekly metrics.
prompt_templates.scenario: Use when establishing a first structured demand program.

prompt_templates.title: Build a Campaign Brief
prompt_templates.prompt: Draft a campaign brief for [offer] targeting [audience] in [region]. Include objectives, budget, channels, UTM naming, success metrics, and sales handoff criteria.
prompt_templates.scenario: Use when preparing one coordinated campaign.

prompt_templates.title: Optimize Channel Performance
prompt_templates.prompt: Evaluate these channel results: [spend, leads, SQLs, customers, revenue]. Calculate CAC, compare efficiency, identify likely bottlenecks, and recommend budget changes with test conditions.
prompt_templates.scenario: Use when reallocating an active acquisition budget.

prompt_templates.title: Design an International Growth System
prompt_templates.prompt: Design a six-month EU and North American acquisition system for [company]. Integrate paid media, SEO, partnerships, HubSpot attribution, experiments, and regional compliance checkpoints.
prompt_templates.scenario: Use for advanced multi-region planning and governance.

output_examples.input: Plan a $40,000 monthly acquisition mix for a Series A B2B SaaS company entering the United States.
output: Channel allocation: LinkedIn 35%, Google Search 30%, SEO 20%, and partnerships 15%.
Primary target: 48 SQLs with a blended CAC below $850.
Measurement: standardized UTM parameters, HubSpot campaign tracking, and weekly channel reviews.

output_examples.input: Calculate CAC for LinkedIn at $15,000 and 10 customers, plus Google Search at $12,000 and 20 customers.
output: Blended CAC: $900 across $27,000 spend and 30 customers.

output_examples.input: Create a quarterly technical SEO review for an international SaaS website.
output: Crawl the site and prioritize errors, redirect chains, duplicate content, mobile issues, and slow pages.
Verify sitemaps, canonical tags, structured data, Core Web Vitals, and regional hreflang tags.
Track fixes, ranking changes, non-brand traffic, and assisted conversions by region.

best_practices: Provide current spend, funnel conversions, customer counts, target regions, and revenue goals.
Validate benchmark recommendations against recent platform data and your own controlled experiments.
Use consistent UTM naming and shared lead-stage definitions before comparing channel performance.
anti_patterns: Do not scale a channel from lead volume alone; include SQL quality, customers, CAC, and revenue.
Do not apply regional recommendations without reviewing current privacy, advertising, and consent requirements.
Do not stop experiments early or treat directional results as statistically reliable conclusions.

faq.question: Does this skill connect directly to advertising platforms?
faq.answer: No. It provides planning and optimization guidance but does not access or modify advertising accounts.

faq.question: Can it calculate customer acquisition cost?
faq.answer: Yes. The bundled Python script calculates channel and blended CAC from spend and customer counts.

faq.question: Does it include HubSpot automation files?
faq.answer: No. It describes HubSpot workflows and reporting, but the referenced workflow templates are not bundled.

faq.question: Which markets does the guidance cover?
faq.answer: The playbook focuses on the European Union, United States, and Canada, with general localization considerations.

faq.question: Are the channel benchmarks guaranteed?
faq.answer: No. They are planning references that require validation against current market conditions and company data.

faq.question: Who benefits most from this skill?
faq.answer: Demand generation, performance marketing, SEO, partnerships, and revenue operations teams at growing B2B SaaS companies.
